title: The Savoy Male and Female College
text:
taken every degree in both rites except the 33rd; in 1918 or 1919 I was Deputy District Grand Master under Grand Master A. L. Randell.

During the recent reunion of the ex-students at Savoy, I re-lived many happy hours, yes, years, in meeting and communing with many of my old school friends, chums, and classmates, some of whom I had not seen for more than fifty years, as I moved from Savoy in 1888. In a troop they are passing before my vision now—Matt Harder, Oliver Mulkey, Lee Clark, W. I., Julia and John Hunt, Clint Mays; Nat, Lee, Pree and Lillie Hampton; Kate King, Maggie Jones, Lee Lindsey, Lee Gorrell, Sam and Edna McKee, Barlow Roberts; Doke, Maggie and Mattie Halsell; and many, many others.

I can recall many incidents of our school life, some extremely ludicrous, some semi-pathetic, all interesting, but perhaps they would be out of place in this sketch, which I fear is already far too long for our very busy but most excellent little historian, who "asked for it."
notes: Printed page number 183. This is the conclusion of L. J. Reynolds' personal sketch. Bottom of page has 'Digitized by Google' watermark.
